R7BD-bear-walk-0001.name: 5.0 km SE of Del Creek
R7BD-bear-walk-0001.pressureWhy: 4.9 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
R7BD-bear-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Burn from 2015 (fire G60167), 310 m SE: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 18 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 90 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Fort Ware, about 40 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.3009, -125.17782, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 4.9 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 703 m, about 168 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-41, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-03-14, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BD-bear-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-41: about 38 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.01 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

R7BD-grouse-atv-0003.name: 600 m W of Del Creek
R7BD-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BD-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
7 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Fort Ware, about 40 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.3009, -125.17782, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 1.2 km to the start. Ride: the Del M/L stretch, 5.1 km one way. About 101 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-41, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-03-14, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BD-grouse-atv-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-41: about 407 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Beginner friendly
tags.why: Quieter spot only 1.2 km from the parking: fewer hunters, short walk back (Tip, estimate).
